org.tmt.aps.peas.visualization.business

Class GraphicDisplayMgmt

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.tmt.aps.peas.visualization.business.GraphicDisplayMgmt
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Serializable

    public class GraphicDisplayMgmt
extends Object
implements Serializable
    Singleton EJB state machine for Visualization displays, user interaction waiting and return states. Also acts as a source of visualization data.
    Author:
    smichaels
